notes: publisher, copyright and url are shown in Add/Remove Programs, the installer and the executables' Properties > Details. They are placeholders: set them to the organisation that distributes the product (an empty copyright becomes 'Copyright (C) <year> <publisher>'). appId must never change once an installer has been released (it is how upgrades find the installed copy).
